steps.name: Yogurt silo
steps.does: Raw milk waits at 4 °C in the wing's own silo, topped up by tanker from the shared bay.

steps.name: Standardization skid
steps.does: Cream is taken off at 40% fat until the milk carries just enough fat for 3.0% in the mix.

steps.name: Powder station and high-shear mixer
steps.does: Skim-milk powder, drawn into the flow by the mixer, raises the solids-not-fat from 8.7% to 11%.

steps.name: Stabilizer skid
steps.does: 0.3% stabilizer is dosed in, so the gel holds its water; the mix is now about 14% dry matter.

steps.name: Mix tank
steps.does: An agitated tank keeps the powder in suspension and feeds the heat treatment.

steps.name: Deaerator
steps.does: Under vacuum the air comes out of the mix, so it does not foam or burn onto the plates.

steps.name: Homogenizer
steps.does: At 180 bar and about 68 °C the fat globules are broken up, so no cream rises and less whey weeps from the gel.

steps.name: Plate heat exchanger: heating
steps.does: Hot water lifts the mix to 92 °C; the regeneration section recovers most of the heat from the mix coming back.

steps.name: Holding cell
steps.does: A serpentine tube holds the mix at 92 °C for 5 min: the whey proteins denature and will build into the gel.

steps.name: Divert valve (CCP)
steps.does: Under 85 °C, or held under 3 min, the mix is sent back to the reprocess tank instead of forward.

steps.name: Reprocess tank
steps.does: Mix that was not heat-treated waits here and goes to rework while the wing cleans the line.

steps.name: Plate heat exchanger: cooling
steps.does: The mix gives its heat back to the incoming mix and leaves at 43 °C, the culture's temperature.

steps.name: Culture dosing
steps.does: Starter culture, L. bulgaricus and S. thermophilus, is injected into the 43 °C mix in step with the flow.

steps.name: Set yogurt: straight to the buffer
steps.does: Set yogurt skips the tanks: it goes to the P8 buffer warm and sets in the cup.

steps.name: Fermentation tank 1
steps.does: Stirred yogurt ferments in an insulated tank until its pH falls from 6.6 to 4.55, about 4 h at 43 °C.

steps.name: Fermentation tank 2
steps.does: Only one tank fills at a time; the tanks take turns filling, fermenting, waiting and emptying.

steps.name: Fermentation tank 3
steps.does: A ready tank is cooled at once, so its pH holds, and is cleaned in place once it is empty.

steps.name: Smoothing valve
steps.does: The curd from the oldest ready tank is smoothed at low shear, so it does not thin.

steps.name: Plate cooler
steps.does: Stirred yogurt is cooled to 18 °C on its way to the buffer; set yogurt skips it.

steps.name: Fruit dosing
steps.does: For a fruit recipe a pump doses the fruit preparation in line, 15% of the flow.

steps.name: P8 buffer
steps.does: The buffer feeds the filler's manifold under steady pressure; set mix may wait in it at most 45 min.

steps.name: De-nester
steps.does: Suction cups pull empty cups from 12 magazines into the carrier's pockets, 12 a cycle.

steps.name: Ionized air and UV-C
steps.does: Ionized air loosens dust, a vacuum takes it off, and UV-C light disinfects the cups' insides.

steps.name: Piston fillers
steps.does: Twelve volumetric pistons fill each cup with about 127 g, through anti-drip nozzles.

steps.name: Foil pick and sealing heads
steps.does: A foil is placed on each cup and heat-sealed: 180–220 °C, 0.8–1.2 s, 4–6 bar.

steps.name: Coder
steps.does: Each lid is printed with the batch code and its best-before date.

steps.name: Checkweigher
steps.does: Every cup is weighed; under 120.5 g or over 135 g it is kicked out.

steps.name: Metal detector
steps.does: Ferrous, non-ferrous and stainless fragments reject the cup.

steps.name: Vision check
steps.does: A camera checks each lid's placement and its print; a bad one rejects the cup.

steps.name: Seal test
steps.does: Every 2 h of running, 5 cups are tested for leaks; a failure holds every cup since the last pass.

steps.name: Tray packer
steps.does: A pick-and-place head packs the cups 24 to a tray.

steps.name: Palletizer and wrapper
steps.does: A robot stacks 120 trays on a pallet, one batch to a pallet, and the wrapper winds it in film.

steps.name: Warm room
steps.does: Set yogurt sets in the cup at 43 °C until its pH is 4.60; stirred yogurt skips it.

steps.name: Blast chiller
steps.does: Cold air at −2 °C brings each pallet's core down to 4 °C.

steps.name: Cold room
steps.does: At 2–4 °C the gel firms for at least 24 h; a pallet is released once its seal tests have passed.

steps.name: Reefer dock
steps.does: Refrigerated trucks take 26 released pallets each, oldest first, within 48 h.
